descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S03 Agreements screen: the two boxes decide Continue, in the UI and on the server; Continue stores the acceptance once

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 On first sign-in, before any AI feature can be used, one agreements screen shows: the AI consent, links to the Terms of Use and the BAA, and two checkboxes (the agreement and the authorization attest … (UAT OAT-01 step 7; UAT OAT-01 Expected; TFA-94700 AC 7; TFA-94700 AC 8; TFA-94700 AC 9; TFA-94700 AC 11; UAT 3.3)
  • U11 The agreement acceptance is saved with the physician, a timestamp, the document version and both checkbox acceptances. (UAT OAT-01 step 10; TFA-94700 AC 10; TFA-94700 AC 11)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given A brand-new account (freshAccount) signing in through the real form; a signed-in API client for the server cells

When Sign in and read the screen; try /snf by URL; try each box cell in the UI; call settings:recordConsent with one box false; tick both, press Continue, reload.

Then 'Before you start' shows the AI provider list, the no-training line and the disclaimer, and links to the Privacy Policy, Terms of Use and Business Associate Agreement (new tab). Nothing behind the screen opens, even by URL. Neither box (the start state) -> Continue disabled, Decline enabled. Agreement only -> disabled. Attestation only -> disabled. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): consent.spec.ts assertions per cell (toBeDisabled / toBeEnabled, recordConsent rejects, stored() equals NOTHING, the stored row's fields), judged against U7 (content, links, two boxes, gate before any AI feature) and U11 (physician, timestamp, document version, both boxes). The 'neither box' cell is asserted by the first-screen test, the one-box cells by the both-boxes test. …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S03

Existing specs:

  • consent.spec.ts [chromium] — Continue needs both boxes; one alone leaves it disabled — expected
  • consent.spec.ts [chromium] — Continue opens the app, is stored with the server's time, version and both boxes, and is not asked again — expected
  • consent.spec.ts [chromium] — the server refuses an acceptance with a box unticked — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A runs Tim's Playwright specs, which sign in their own fixture accounts and need the admin key; dev has neither (runner-contract §10), so this runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14). A scripted dev check of part of it ran: OAT-01-agreements (Pass).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
